title: Zelenskyy announces agreement on Patriot interceptor missiles for Ukraine
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Zelenskyy announces agreement on Patriot interceptor missiles for Ukraine

Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced a key agreement on a package of Patriot air defence missiles for Ukraine, keeping the supplying partner unnamed.

Actual Article Body:
Долучайтеся до клубу УП!

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has announced that Ukraine has agreed on the delivery of a package of missiles for Patriot air defence systems.

Source: European Pravda, citing Zelenskyy during a meeting with representatives and leaders of the Ukrainian community in the US

Details: The president announced a new contribution to strengthening Ukrainian air defence but did not specify which country agreed to provide the assistance.

Quote: "Today we agreed, I won't say with whom, on a package of missiles for Patriot systems. An important decision, very important. There is a result."
